zh.sourceText: 市教育局就是否引入 AI 助教向学校征求意见。研发方称，早期测试中 AI 助教让班级平均分提升了 12 分，而且能解放教师重复批改的时间。综合前期意见，市教育局宣布，下学期起在 30 所中学试点 AI 助教，由系统为每个学生生成个性化练习。教育学者随即提醒，个性化练习依赖学生答题数据，存在隐私外泄的风险。一位受访教师补充，学生更愿意向不会嘲笑自己的程序提问，课堂参与更主动。不过也有家长质疑，机器能否替代师生间的情感陪伴。某培训机构借势推广：用了 AI 助教，孩子半年上清北！

textRefs.conclusion_1: 下学期起在 30 所中学试点 AI 助教
textRefs.reason_1: 早期测试中 AI 助教让班级平均分提升了 12 分
textRefs.reason_2: 学生更愿意向不会嘲笑自己的程序提问，课堂参与更主动
textRefs.reason_3: 能解放教师重复批改的时间
textRefs.distractor_1: 个性化练习依赖学生答题数据
textRefs.distractor_2: 用了 AI 助教，孩子半年上清北

hints: 结论夹在证据与风险提醒之间：哪一句真正决定要采取什么行动？
理由分散在结论前后，分别从数据、效率和心理角度提供支持
陷阱：『依赖答题数据』听起来像在说效率，其实是在提醒风险；培训广告更不是理由
zh.explanation: 结论是「在 30 所中学试点 AI 助教」。三条理由分别是：①数据——平均分提升 12 分；②效率——解放教师重复批改；③心理——学生敢向不嘲笑人的程序提问。注意「个性化练习依赖学生答题数据」看似在讲功能，实际是学者提出的隐私风险，并不是支持试点的理由；「半年上清北」是培训机构的夸张广告。结论夹在理由与反对意见之间，不能再靠第一句或连续高亮的位置猜答案。

en.sourceText: The education bureau asked schools for views on introducing AI teaching assistants. The developer says that in early tests AI assistants raised the class average by 12 points and freed teachers from repetitive grading. After reviewing the early feedback, the bureau announced that starting next semester, AI teaching assistants will be piloted in 30 middle schools, with the system generating personalized practice for each student. Education scholars then warn that personalized practice relies on student answer data and risks privacy leaks. An interviewed teacher added that students are more willing to ask a program that will not laugh at them, making class participation more active. Some parents still question whether machines can replace the emotional bond between teachers and students. A training agency is cashing in: use AI assistants and your child gets into a top university in half a year!

textRefs.conclusion_1: starting next semester, AI teaching assistants will be piloted in 30 middle schools
textRefs.reason_1: in early tests AI assistants raised the class average by 12 points
textRefs.reason_2: students are more willing to ask a program that will not laugh at them, making class participation more active
textRefs.distractor_1: personalized practice relies on student answer data
textRefs.distractor_2: use AI assistants and your child gets into a top university in half a year

hints: The conclusion sits between evidence and a risk warning: which sentence commits to an action?
Reasons are scattered before and after it, supporting the move through data, efficiency, and psychology
Trap: 'relies on answer data' sounds like a feature but is a privacy risk; the ad is not a reason
en.explanation: The conclusion is 'pilot AI teaching assistants in 30 middle schools'. Three reasons: ① data — average up 12 points; ② efficiency — frees teachers from repetitive grading; ③ psychology — students dare ask a program that won't laugh. 'Personalized practice relies on student answer data' sounds functional but is actually a privacy risk, not support for the pilot; 'top university in half a year' is an agency's exaggeration. The conclusion now sits among reasons and objections, so its role cannot be guessed from the first sentence or a block of adjacent highlights.
